description: Add private key identities to the OpenSSH authentication agent.

option.name: -c
tip: Indicate that added identities should be subject to confirmation before use.
Confirmation is performed by ssh-askpass.

option.name: -C
tip: Process certificates only and skip plain keys when loading or deleting keys.

option.name: -d
tip: Remove identities from the agent instead of adding them.
Arguments are treated as paths to public key files.

option.name: -D
tip: Delete all identities from the agent.

option.name: -e
tip: Remove keys provided by the PKCS#11 shared library at the given path.

option.name: -E
tip: Specify the hash algorithm used when displaying key fingerprints.
Possible values: md5, sha256
The default is sha256.

option.name: -h
tip: Constrain added keys to specific hosts or destinations.
Forms: [user@]hostname or src-hostname>[user@]dst-hostname; wildcards are allowed.

option.name: -H
tip: Specify a known_hosts file to look up host keys for destination-constrained keys.
May be specified multiple times.

option.name: -k
tip: Process plain private keys only and skip certificates when loading or deleting keys.

option.name: -K
tip: Load resident keys from a FIDO authenticator.

option.name: -l
tip: List the fingerprints of all identities in the agent.

option.name: -L
tip: List the public key parameters of all identities in the agent.

option.name: -N
tip: Do not request automatic deletion of added certificates after their expiry.

option.name: -P
tip: Do not request a PIN when loading PKCS#11 or FIDO keys.

option.name: -q
tip: Be quiet after a successful operation.

option.name: -Q
tip: Query the agent for the list of protocol extensions it supports.
Not all agents support this query.

option.name: -s
tip: Add keys provided by the PKCS#11 shared library at the given path.
Certificate files may optionally be listed as arguments.

option.name: -S
tip: Specify a path to a library used when adding FIDO authenticator-hosted keys.

option.name: -t
tip: Set a maximum lifetime when adding identities to the agent.
The lifetime is in seconds or in a time format from sshd_config(5).

option.name: -T
tip: Test whether the private keys for the given public key files are usable by signing and verifying.

option.name: -v
tip: Verbose mode.
Print debugging messages about progress.
Multiple -v options increase verbosity, up to a maximum of 3.

option.name: -x
tip: Lock the agent with a password.

option.name: -X
tip: Unlock the agent.
